request: Duidelijk keuzepaneel en oefenlijn direct bouwen; ontbrekende mogelijkheden zichtbaar grijs.
base: Existing uncommitted level-route implementation in canonical Klink checkout; no reset or new app.
changes: Start shows Kies je oefenroute without a disclosure. Literacy Alfa A/B/C and language A1/A2/B1 remain separate axes.
Existing source labels determine availability. Alfa C and B1 remain visible, disabled and labelled Nog niet beschikbaar. Availability is not course completeness or personal attainment.
Choosing a level stays on Start. Bekijk mijn oefeningen explicitly opens word practice for the selected literacy route, or texts for a language-only choice. Both settings remain stored separately.
Photo help is separate from the level choice. Example and situation images remain visible; no media or audio connections changed.
Six numbered learning steps are visible on Start and actionable within Samen oefenen. Stage navigation focuses the relevant heading; current stage is not marked as completed.
Unavailable exercise stages remain grey with Nog niet bij deze keuze. Existing harder sources are not falsely described as missing.
Image growth shows existing word images, comparison and situations, with grey placeholders for unproduced image stories and practical document images.
All fifteen photo cards, original word groupings, saved results and fixed exercise canvas retained.

checks.productionBuild: passed; existing static API-classification warning, no build error

designBasis.source: Existing TAALROUTE-ONTWERPBASIS.md and lesson-specific guidance retained.
designBasis.teacherAction: Choose literacy and language separately with the learner; use the visible steps to locate existing tasks.
designBasis.learnerAction: Choose, explicitly open practice, navigate to a learning step, and request photo help when needed.
designBasis.observation: Navigation choice is never recorded as demonstrated language mastery. No extra course time or completed level claimed.
designBasis.style: Existing typography, Lucide icons and controls reused. Referenced DigiBord style directory still absent; no replacement style invented.
